blocks.text: In dev, the image provides dependencies, a bind mount provides source, and `uvicorn --reload` restarts on changes, with no rebuild per edit.

blocks.code:
# compose.override.yaml
services:
  api:
    build: { context: ., target: dev }
    command: ["uvicorn","app.main:app","--host","0.0.0.0","--reload","--reload-dir","/app/app"]
    volumes:
      - ./app:/app/app            # source only
    environment:
      WATCHFILES_FORCE_POLLING: "true"   # only if file events don't arrive
    ports: ["127.0.0.1:8000:8000"]

rows: Mounting `.:/app` shadows the image's venv with a host (maybe macOS) .venv
Mount hides image content at that path
No reload on Windows/NTFS or some VM shares
Keep code in WSL2 FS or enable polling

items: Never ship `--reload`: keep it in the dev target or override file.
Compose Watch (sync instead of mount) avoids most performance and permission issues.

blocks.text: Q: "How do you get hot reload in Docker without breaking dependencies?" A: "Bake dependencies into the image, bind-mount only the source directory, and run uvicorn --reload in a dev-only override. Never mount the whole project, which drags in a host venv, and never ship --reload."
